The '''home base''' of the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Amorris]].<ref name="DFR" /> By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="SoTP Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]</ref> the pirates had abandoned the base for a [[Cavrilhu's Kauron base|new one]] in the [[Kauron asteroid field]].<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
